problem.label: El Problema
problem.title: El código tributario de Filadelfia no fue diseñado para la fuerza laboral moderna
problem.intro1: all businesses in Philadelphia are about to be hit with a new—and probably surprise—tax bill.
problem.intro2: the smallest businesses in Philadelphia had a shield from the regressive Business Income and Receipts Tax
problem.scale_text: most people don't realize the scale of the impact it's about to have on Philadelphians who run an individual business as a way to simply survive.

local.description: Cada dólar retenido por un filadelfiano se convierte en tres dólares en gasto local.
